newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit weak, but in range as volume stays low.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit weak, but in range as volume stays low.

text.p: The ringgit was boxed in a 10-point range in late Asian trading after some early decline triggered by dollar/yen's strength, dealers said on Thursday.
They said mild commercial demand for the dollar from Kuala Lumpur also caused the Malaysian unit's fall early on.
However, lack of market participation in post-Christmas trading kept it confined to a tight range.
"This is how it will be for the next few days, unless there is major movement in the dollar/majors," one dealer said.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5280/90 a dollar.
